nome_jp: 神聖騎 オルタナティブ
testo:
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone. If you have a tooltip in the battle zone, destroy the chosen creature. If you don't, that creature gets -6000 power until the end of the turn.
